note: Synthetic data for the example: Acme Books, its client and these policies are invented.

policies.title: Chart of accounts
policies.text: The ledger's account names map to these account numbers. Assets: 1500 equipment. Income: 4000 sales. Expenses: 5000 ingredients, 6100 rent, 6200 utilities, 6300 payroll, 6400 software, 6500 marketing, 6600 repairs, 6700 bank fees. Every expense report shows the number beside the name, as 6100 rent.

policies.title: Capitalizing equipment
policies.text: Equipment bought for $500 or more is capitalized to 1500 equipment and depreciated; it is never reported as an expense. Equipment under $500 is expensed under 6600 repairs.

policies.title: Duplicate entries
policies.text: A suspected duplicate stays in every total until the accountant confirms it, and the report says how much the total would fall if it were removed.
